claims.quote: The highest proportion of CSE occurred in patients with SCN1A-associated DEEs, including 181/203 (89%; 95% CI 84-93) patients with Dravet syndrome
The highest proportion of CSE occurred in patients with SCN1A-associated DEEs, including 181/203 (89%; 95% CI 84-93) patients with Dravet syndrome and 8/15 (53%; 95% CI 27-79) non-Dravet SCN1A-DEEs.
NCSE was common in patients with non-Dravet SCN1A-DEEs (8/15; 53%; 95% CI 27-79)
Four genes were associated with SUDEP: SCN1A, SCN2A, SCN8A, and STXBP1.
